subject: VantageAI capacity runway & temporary reserve (late-stage)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VantageAI capacity runway check + temporary reserve

Team — quick ask, late-stage conversation with VantageAI (see thread below). They want to target a production start 2026-11-01 for a rollout that will initially need capacity equivalent to ~20x A100-80GB GPUs for model serving (mostly 8k-context chat workloads; expected peak token throughput ~4M tokens/day). They are willing to sign a 3–6 month reserved plan pending SLA and procurement approvals.

Can infra confirm:
- What can we hold in us-west for a soft reserve between 2026-10-15 and 2027-01-15?
- If we can’t hit 20 units, what’s the realistic convertible mix (e.g., 10 A100 + 6 H100 + 4 quantized instances) and expected perf delta?
- Ops: estimate the cost delta for 90-day reserved vs on-demand for this profile.

I attached a quick demand estimate (vantage_mop_estimate.xlsx) and a 30/60/90 runway heatmap (runway-heatmap-q4.pdf). We need a short internal decision today to propose a mutual action plan and give the customer a firm reserved window.

Ben
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VantageAI capacity runway check + temporary reserve

Ben — quick inventory check from infra: current dedicated pool in us-west shows ~14 A100-equivalent slots unconstrained for Nov 1 start. We can free up an additional 6 units by converting low-priority batch nodes (reprovision) but that will require a maintenance window and will reduce batch throughput for two weeks.

Convertible mix suggestion (realistic):
- 12x A100-80GB (native)
- 6x H100-80GB (higher perf on FP16 workloads; needs minor kernel tuning)
- 2x quantized L4 instances (good for lower-latency embeddings and low-precision tasks)

Perf delta: mixing H100 gives ~20% throughput improvement on FP16 heavy workloads; quantized nodes reduce memory pressure but need model quantization validation (approx 10–15% output drift risk).

Cost note: a 90-day reserved commitment with a 30% uplift vs current committed rates is roughly 18% cheaper than on-demand for this mix; Ops to provide a detailed cost table.

I’ll open an ops ticket to request a soft hold on 20 slots from 2026-10-15 through 2027-01-15 (ticket OPS-9124). That will not fully allocate resources until we receive legal/po, but it prevents scheduler reallocation.

—Karthik
Head of Dedicated Capacity Planning
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VantageAI capacity runway check + temporary reserve

Thanks Karthik — this aligns with the ask. Sales side: VantageAI has pushed budget approval to procurement but has verbally committed to a Nov 1 pilot. My recommended course:

1) Propose a 6-week soft hold (no billed cost) to be converted to a 90-day reserved contract upon PO + DocuSign. That gives them runway to finalize SOW.
2) Offer a starter reserved band: 12 guaranteed units + 8 flexible (we can provide H100 or quantized variants) — allows them to scale to 20 without immediate hardware lock.
3) Offer a 15% volume discount for a 90-day commitment, and a 5% additional credit if they sign within 14 days.

I’ll push procurement to accept redlines; Legal is standing by for a short SOW. Ben — can you confirm whether we should present the mixed-hardware option or insist on A100 equivalents for the pilot? Also tagging Hannah to confirm ops ticket and SLA ask.

Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
From: Elena Wu <elena@vantage.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@vantage.ai>, ops@vantage.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VantageAI capacity runway check + temporary reserve

Ben/Marissa — thanks for the quick response and the attachments. Confirming VantageAI’s intent:

- Target pilot start: 2026-11-01.
- Initial footprint: 20 A100-equivalent GPUs (we prefer native A100 but are open to H100 where performance testing validates parity).
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for the reserved band; encryption at rest + in transit; SOC2 evidence already requested separately.

Procurement will need a soft-reserve hold until their PO clears (expected within 10–14 business days). A DocuSign link to a short SOW + reserved capacity appendix would help accelerate.

Elena
Head of Platform Engineering
VantageAI
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Summary and next steps (internal):

- Karthik to confirm OPS-9124 soft-hold creation and ensure it blocks scheduler reallocation from 2026-10-15 to 2027-01-15. If we can only ledger 18 units, we proceed with 12 native A100 + 6 H100 + 0 quantized for pilot; ops to document expected perf delta.
- Marissa to send SOW + reserved appendix draft for 90-day term with the 15% discount and early-sign credit; include DocuSign link and standard SLA (99.9%). Draft due 2026-09-29 EOD.
- Ben to push for PO cadence; if procurement needs additional evidence, forward SOC2 + retention policy docs (linked in HubSpot).
- Hannah to confirm capacity-release window and escalate to pool owners if we need to decommission batch nodes; target decision by 2026-09-30.

Attachments: vantage_mop_estimate.xlsx, runway-heatmap-q4.pdf (same as sent to customer).

Ben
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
